evidence_stage: v101.53 - promotes v101.52 and v101.53 to production on top of the v101.51 baseline. v101.52 is the first release since v101.44 in which the corpus itself changes: the approved targeted change set. Part A - 21 mandatory wording corrections, applied as minimal clause-level edits (21 CHANGED, 0 already present, 0 unmapped; measured against the untouched v101.51 corpus, exactly 21 of 1,839 records changed, 0 unrelated). Part C - 65 approved non-destructive display segmentations (180 display units): canonical record ids, order and text unchanged, each record's segment slices concatenate back to its canonical text exactly, rendered through the existing renderParaTextRange() in canonical coordinates so highlights, notes, favourites and saved positions keep resolving through the canonical parent id with no migration. Part E - 4 cross-record continuity operations, both stable ids preserved in every group. Part F - the 3 expressly excluded stylistic constructions left untouched. Speech offsets recalculated by exact delta for the 7 affected records, with any boundary falling inside a replaced span refused rather than approximated. The v101.44 protected-declaration contract is re-baselined at v101.52 (CORPUS and SPEECH_DATA moved; TEXT_LIBRARY, HOUR_LINKED_TEXTS, INTERNAL_SUBHEADINGS and SPEECH_END_VISUAL_BREAKS unchanged), not dropped. v101.53 is an app-only fix on top: the bottom navigation bar was covering the end of a view on iPad (reported on the Approfondir screen) because iOS Safari excludes a flex-column scroll container's padding-bottom from its scrollable overflow; the reserved space is now held by a flex-item spacer instead, which cannot be dropped by that Safari behaviour. Corpus unchanged since v101.52.
real_device_status: CONFIRMED - Louis reviewed the corpus text corrections and confirmed the iPad bottom-bar/scroll fix before this promotion.
